subject: Cloud Listing MAP: AWS & GCP Ops Kickstart — timeline & owners
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@nimblecloud.com>, James O'Neal <j.oneal@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Priya Rao <priya@googlecloudpartners.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Cloud Listing MAP: AWS & GCP Ops Kickstart — timeline & owners

Hi Lydia / James / Priya —

Thanks again for committing time to get the Nimble Cloud listing across AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace. I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear owners, a compact evaluation plan, and a realistic go-live window. Attached is a first-draft MAP (Nimble_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) — please review and suggest edits.

High-level objective:
- Complete marketplace listing and integration for Nimble Cloud by 2026-12-22 (target week) with staged rollouts (private listing -> public listing) and joint marketing after go-live.

Proposed milestones & owners (please confirm):
1) Discovery & requirements (this week) — Owner: Rachel (Redwood) + Lydia (Nimble)
2) Technical validation (AMIs/container artifacts, billing hooks, SSO) — Owner: Alex Martinez (Redwood Eng) + Nimble infra lead
3) Compliance & legal (terms, listing copy, privacy) — Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood Marketplace PM) + Nimble legal
4) Listing prep & submission (marketplace portal artifacts, screenshots) — Owner: Sergio Alvarez (Partner Ops) + AWS/GCP partner reps
5) Final verification & go/no-go — Joint decision; target gate: 2026-12-20

Suggested evaluation plan (short):
- Week 1 (11/28–12/04): Requirements, IAM & artifact checklist, security questionnaire kickoff
- Week 2 (12/05–12/11): Tech validation (smoke tests + billing flows), resolve infra gaps
- Week 3 (12/12–12/18): Legal review, listing copy, portal submission to AWS/GCP
- Week 4 (12/19–12/22): Final verification and go-live window; contingency buffer to 12/29

Ask for partners: can you please confirm the internal Nimble owners for infra & legal by EOD Wednesday (11/30)? Also confirm whether the target go-live window (week of 12/22) works for AWS/GCP partner ops, or if we should aim for the prior week.

Attachments: Nimble_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP template)

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for this Friday; if you'd prefer a different cadence please let me know.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127
From: Lydia Park <lydia@nimblecloud.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, James O'Neal <j.oneal@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Priya Rao <priya@googlecloudpartners.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T12:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cloud Listing MAP: AWS & GCP Ops Kickstart — timeline & owners

Rachel / Team —

Really appreciate the clear plan. Nimble is on board and I've looped in our infra lead (Tom Beck) offline — he will be primary for artifact delivery. Quick notes after a first pass:

- Owners: confirm Rachel / Lydia for discovery; Tom Beck (tom.beck@nimblecloud.com) for infra; Maya Singh (maya.singh@nimblecloud.com) for legal/compliance.
- Timeline: we prefer go-live in the week of 12/29 if possible. We have a major internal release the week of 12/22 and want a buffer. If AWS/GCP need earlier submission windows, we can prioritize listing prep earlier but would prefer public launch 12/29.
- Security evidence: we'll need the Redwood security questionnaire completed for our compliance team. I've attached Nimble's partner requirements doc for your intake.

Attachment: nimble_partner_requirements.pdf

On timing — James / Priya, are there any mandatory portal lead times or blackouts in late December we should be aware of?

Thanks,
Lydia
Head of Partnerships | Nimble Cloud
lydia@nimblecloud.com
+1 (617) 555-2089
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia@nimblecloud.com>, James O'Neal <j.oneal@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Priya Rao <priya@googlecloudpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cloud Listing MAP: AWS & GCP Ops Kickstart — timeline & owners

Appreciate the kickoff. Quick technical checklist and notes (so we have explicit deliverables):

- AWS Marketplace (SaaS listing) artifacts: registration doc, screenshots, usage test account, IAM role or API key for validation, billing hooks (URL + sample payload), support contact. Owner: Alex Martinez (Redwood) / Tom Beck (Nimble). ETA for artifacts: 12/09.
- GCP Marketplace (container/VM): container image URIs, deployment template, SOC2 attestation excerpt, support matrix. Owner: Alex Martinez / Tom Beck. ETA: 12/11.
- SSO: SAML/OIDC flow details, metadata XML — Owner: Tom Beck / Redwood SSO team; Redwood to provide test SP metadata by 12/03.
- Test plan: Redwood will run a smoke test of billing + SSO flows in a test org; need a test account from Nimble by 12/06.

I'll drop a shared folder for artifacts here: https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-nimble-marketplace-artifacts — please upload artifacts to the relevant subfolders (aws/, gcp/, legal/).

If the public launch sits on 12/29, we should still aim to submit portal artifacts for review by AWS/GCP by 12/12 to accommodate review cycles. If that timing is tight we'll triage which items are blocking.

—Alex
Principal Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@nimblecloud.com>, James O'Neal <j.oneal@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Priya Rao <priya@googlecloudpartners.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cloud Listing MAP: AWS & GCP Ops Kickstart — timeline & owners

Thanks everyone — helpful inputs. Summarizing updated plan and next steps (agreed items):

- Go-live target: public listing week of 12/29 (contingency buffer through 1/05 if any portal delays).
- Confirmed owners:
  - Discovery & roadmap: Rachel Kim (Redwood) + Lydia Park (Nimble)
  - Tech artifacts & validation: Alex Martinez (Redwood) + Tom Beck (Nimble)
  - Marketplace program & listing copy: Marissa Cole (Redwood) + Nimble marketing
  - Portal submission & ops: Sergio Alvarez (Redwood) + James O'Neal (AWS) / Priya Rao (GCP)
  - Legal & compliance: Marissa Cole + Maya Singh (Nimble)

- Action items (owners / due dates):
  1) Nimble: confirm Tom & Maya contact details and upload partner artifacts to Drive (due 12/01) — Owner: Lydia
  2) Redwood: deliver test SP metadata & sample billing hook payload (due 12/03) — Owner: Alex
  3) Nimble: provide test account for smoke tests (due 12/06) — Owner: Tom Beck
  4) Joint: portal artifacts submitted for review (target 12/12) — Owners: Sergio / James / Priya
  5) Nimble & Redwood: complete security questionnaire (attached) — due 12/08

Attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx

Next meeting: I've scheduled a 30-min sync on Thursday 12/02 at 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent. Please flag if that time doesn't work.

If anyone needs a faster cadence, we can move to twice-weekly check-ins as we hit the portal submission window.

Cheers,
Rachel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
